Various Mineral Specimens
Eclectic Geological and Decorative Stone Collection
Natural Stone, Slag Glass, and Metal
7.8 lbs Total Weight
Unsigned
This comprehensive collection features a diverse array of geological specimens and decorative stone objects, weighing a total of 7.8 pounds. The lot is anchored by a significant piece of cobalt blue cullet or slag glass, prized for its intense coloration and characteristic glassy conchoidal fracture. Accompanying the raw specimens is a curated selection of polished tumbled stones, including rose quartz, snowflake obsidian, amethyst, and iron pyrite, providing a broad survey of mineral textures and colors. A polished green stone egg and a set of stone-topped picks add a decorative functional element to the assembly.
Set of 9 metal decorative forks/picks featuring various stone cabochon handles including carnelian and quartz
Wide variety of minerals ranging from raw crystalline quartz and field specimens to polished aventurine and obsidian
Substantial cobalt blue slag glass specimen with characteristic swirling textures and vibrant translucency
